# An Honest Absence

In the reopened Reading Room, Mara, Ilyra, and Nessa enter the first deliberate omission into a new ledger. Ilyra returns the restricted-vault key. Oren arrives with a message from Sable, and the Archive begins again by recording what it refuses to centralize.
